steps.say: Welcome, agent. I am your contact. What is your name?
Good. The code word is hidden in this café. Ask the waiter for a coffee.
The waiter asks: Anything else? Tell him you want a sandwich.
Passport control. Where are you from?
steps.ar: قل من أين أنت: I am from ...

steps.say: What is the purpose of your visit?
steps.ar: قل إنك هنا للسياحة أو العمل

steps.say: How many days will you stay?
A notebook is missing from the classroom. Ask your teacher where it is.
Maybe it is on the desk. Ask a classmate: Do you have a pen?
Say thank you to your teacher.
Good evening. A table for how many people?
What would you like to drink?
steps.ar: اطلب مشروباً: I would like water

steps.say: Here is the menu. Ask for the bill when you finish.
Welcome to the shop. Can I help you?
steps.ar: قل: I am looking for a jacket

steps.say: Here it is. Ask about the price.
It is fifty dollars. Tell him you will take it.
